where_set: tdp_limit / tdc_limit / max_tdp_limit / asic_fmax live in the chip_limits block of the firmware table (FwTable) in the card SPI ROM (pyluwen spirom_tables.rs: struct ChipLimits). tt-smi 6.6.0 has no option to set them; hwmon power1_max / curr1_max are read-only (r--r--r--); no runtime ARC message for a TDP override found in tt-smi / pyluwen. Changing them = writing the SPI ROM firmware table = firmware change. We did not change them.
